description: This Java source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates image pixelization effects, including custom pixelization, built-in bitmap scaling, and asynchronous processing. It includes UI controls like a SeekBar and menu options for animation and toggling pixelization methods.

classes.name: ImagePixelization
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating image pixelization effects, UI interactions, and background processing.

classes.name: PixelizeImageAsyncTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass for performing pixelization in background to keep UI responsive.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, loads image, sets up UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: checkIfShouldPixelize
methods.description: Checks if enough time has passed to trigger pixelization to avoid excessive processing.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for animation and toggles.

methods.name: customImagePixelization
methods.description: Performs pixelization by manually averaging pixel blocks (box blur).

methods.name: builtInPixelization
methods.description: Performs pixelization using bitmap scaling operations for better performance.

methods.name: invokePixelization
methods.description: Triggers pixelization either synchronously or asynchronously based on checkbox.

methods.name: pixelizeImage
methods.description: Selects pixelization method based on user toggle.
